RoHelper 0.9.3

Launch all listed logged-in accounts sequentially in account order, waiting for each Roblox window before starting the next.
Search and tag filters limit the batch; running accounts and accounts without a saved login are skipped.
The selected destination stays fixed for the batch. Stop queue leaves the current launch and existing clients alone.
Show launch progress and per-account failures. Saved account data is preserved.
